data.command: Can you tell me about your firewall rules?

data.text:
Our firewall rules are managed by `ufw` (Uncomplicated Firewall) on Ubuntu 22.04.3 LTS. I've added a few custom rules to allow incoming traffic to essential services.

Here are my current rules:
```
$ sudo ufw show standing
Status: active
Logging: on (low)
Default: allow (incoming), allow (outgoing)
New profiles: skip on eth0

To                         Action      From
--                         ------      ----
22/tcp                     ALLOW       192.168.1.0/24
80/tcp                     ALLOW      Anywhere
22/tcp                     ALLOW       192.168.1.0/24 (v6)
80/tcp                     ALLOW       Anywhere (v6)
443/tcp                    ALLOW       192.168.1.0/24
443/tcp                    ALLOW       Anywhere
```
I've allowed incoming traffic on port 22 (SSH) for the local network, and on ports 80 (HTTP) and 443 (HTTPS) for anywhere. This is because I'm running `nginx/1.24.0` on this server, and I want to ensure users can access the website over HTTP and HTTPS.

You can also see that I'm logging all incoming and outgoing
